title: Quasinormal Modes of Extremal Reissner-Nordstrom Black Holes via Seiberg-Witten Quantization
summary: We study the scalar perturbations of asymptotically flat extremal Reissner-Nordström black holes via the quantum Seiberg-Witten geometry of $\mathcal{N}=2$ SU(2) gauge theory with $N_f=2$ flavors. The radial master equation, governed by a double confluent Heun equation, is exactly mapped to the quantum Seiberg-Witten curve, providing an exact quantization condition derived from the non-perturbative Nekrasov-Shatashvili free energy.
